write.prompt: Some schools require every student to complete a set number of volunteer hours each year. Do the advantages of this rule outweigh the disadvantages?
mustUse: thesis dùng outweigh kèm phạm vi (for most students…)
một câu nêu tiêu chí vì sao một bên nặng hơn
một điều kiện với provided that / as long as
write.modelAfterSubmit:
A growing number of schools now ask every student to complete a set number of volunteer hours each year. In my opinion, the advantages of this rule outweigh the disadvantages for most students, as long as the hours can be done at flexible times.

The main benefit is that volunteering teaches skills that are rarely learnt in the classroom. When students clean a beach or help younger children with their reading, they have to work in teams, plan tasks and talk to people they do not know. These experiences build confidence and give students a better understanding of their community's needs.

On the other hand, compulsory hours can add pressure to an already full timetable. Students who also attend extra classes may have to give up rest or revision time, and some may fall behind. However, the key question is whether this problem can be reduced, and in most cases it can. If schools allow students to choose weekend activities and spread the hours across the year, the extra workload becomes manageable.

In conclusion, required volunteer hours do take time, but their benefits for students' skills and confidence last much longer. Provided that schools keep the system flexible, the rule is a positive one.
